specific_prose_corrections: Snapshot columns, feature columns and candidate sample rows are defined before their formulas. Function and coefficient ordering, subscripts and return objects are connected to hand examples.
Data energy is defined as sum of squared singular values = squared Frobenius norm, with U² units for same-scale state data. It is distinct from physical energy and new-trajectory prediction.
The two-room Galerkin first step and three-room initial projection are derived with units. Known-L projection dynamics and a pure data fit are described according to their actual inputs.
DMD past/next pairs are explained as one-step regressions. Null directions, truncated pseudoinverse, signed amplitude rate and the integer alias branches are separated from multi-step testing.
Koopman acts linearly on functions. The triangular dictionary is proved closed row by row; its mixed feature units and state readout are explicit.

Short EDMD refitting is distinct from deleting a block. Symmetric notebook training happens to give the same remaining coefficients, while positive-x web training redistributes the omitted forcing; a non-symmetric 0.36 hand example explains this.

Four sparse thresholds in the stored experiment retain the same [x,x²] support. Column scaling, equality at the threshold, stopping, original-scale coefficients and index ordering are explained without claiming absent plotted deletion.

The finite derivative contract remains equidistant. Central/end noise variance, fixed step and units bridge difference calculations to both regression sides. Repeated ranges are not called confidence intervals.
The Lorenz coefficient check uses clean true derivatives and the explicit ten-function order; it is separated from noisy derivative estimation and unperformed long-time comparisons.
Column balance, nonnegative transfers and Euler matrix conditions are derived separately, including a total-preserving negative first-step example and volume-weighted concentration condition.

The shared comparison reports initial projection versus autonomous rollout, whole-table RMSE, maximum weighted total error and negative cells. Single-room evaluation and update-11 input are separate tasks.
The capstone main demo fits DMD only and is described that way; other functions support its independent exercises.
All five web views now explain their actual training domains, perturbation form, axes and sampling. Numerical model functions, slider conditions and event handlers are unchanged.
